**STEP 3 - Items:** Cooked bacon (pan-fried, crisp edges). Small crumbs are visible but negligible. No oil or sauce is clearly visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Bacon covers roughly 12% of the plate (about 38 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The bacon is folded into a pile about 0.5 cm thick on average. 38 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 19 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** 19 ml × 0.9 g/ml ≈ 17 g. Bacon is fatty, so the bulk density is low for a dense meat; I keep ~17 g as the best estimate for the visible pile.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Cooked pan-fried bacon ≈ 540 kcal/100 g. 17 g × 5.4 ≈ 92 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Three to four thin cooked bacon strips weigh roughly 12–20 g and contain about 70–110 kcal, which matches. The total is plausible for what is visible.

**Result:** About 17 g of bacon, about 92 kcal.
